subject: Linguistics
title: Writing and Language History
description: A short lesson to help you apply Writing and Language History.

hook.text: The oldest known sentence is Sumerian, from about 3200 BCE. Before writing, language left no trace.

buildup.text: Writing systems preserve snapshots of language—but most of humanity's linguistic past is unwritten.

discovery.text: Historical linguistics can reach further back than any text—the comparative method peers past writing.

twist.text: Writing itself can slow change by creating a conservative standard that speakers try to match.

climax.text: Texts from different centuries let us watch language change in real time—a living documentary.

punchline.text: Writing freezes language—but the spoken word keeps flowing.

quiz.question: How does writing affect language change?
options: It can slow change by creating a conservative standard
